verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API overview tells developers to "import the spec into your favorite API tool, such as Postman," which shows a machine-readable API spec is published for download. The developer portal also offers a pre-built Postman collection. missing for 10: explicit naming of the spec format (OpenAPI/Swagger version), a documented download URL or repository, coverage details (e.g., /api vs /client endpoints), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
